build_host.apple_toolchain: Qt6.11 vendor: Xcode15 or newer, SDK14 or newer; selected toolchain recorded per artifact

runtime_target.minimum_rule: max(selected source/API floor, compiler target, every arm64 Mach-O component LC_BUILD_VERSION or LC_VERSION_MIN_MACOSX); then clean-machine test required
runtime_target.filesystem: local writable APFS/HFS+ volume with contained symlinks, atomic same-volume replacement and intended ownership; reject remote/nonlocal destinations
runtime_target.space_rule: full new package staging + prior install backup + replacement + journals and safety reserve; non-overridable

workload.required_evidence: target camera count, codec, resolution, fps, hardware decoder, sustained150s feed progress, playback and export

findings.meaning: Vendor support differs; runnable attempt only when component/API floors pass.
Camera capacity is unmeasured; runtime verification remains mandatory.
Low-memory build may be attempted with reduced parallelism.
Use separately authenticated historical installed build inputs; record exact receipts and hashes.

acceptance.after_sign_in: observed GUI login and healthy matching package required
acceptance.unattended_reboot: authorized automatic login plus observed new boot, intended GUI session and healthy matching package; cold-start evidence separate
acceptance.production: DeveloperID signature + notarization/stapling + final hashes + clean-machine/oldestOS/runtime/recovery matrix
